newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to provide $106 mln for car battery research.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to provide $106 mln for car battery research.

text.p: U.S. Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary signed a $106 million four-year agreement Thursday with the Big Three automakers to back research on a battery for electric cars to compete with gasoline vehicles, the Energy Department said.

The agreement marks the second phase of the five-year-old U.S. Advanced Battery Consortium, a partnership between Chrysler Corp, Ford Motor Co, and General Motors Corp, with the Electric Power Institute.
The first phase involved developing advanced batteries to help make electric vehicles more marketable.
The second phase will include safety and durability tests, and development of manufacturing processes to help lower costs.
